name: core--grafana-dashboard-provisioning
description: Grafana dashboards provisioned in data volume directory

implementation.change: Copy rendered dashboard JSON files to /var/lib/docker-data/koeff-ai-stack/grafana/dashboards/

checks: Task 'Ensure Grafana dashboards data directory' creates /var/lib/docker-data/koeff-ai-stack/grafana/dashboards
Task 'Copy dashboard files to Grafana data volume' copies grafana-dashboard-*.json files
Grafana datasources config references provisioning dashboards directory
